symptom: Homepage grid empty, featured rail empty, spotlight name stuck on "loading"
first_check: Render the page and read the console; count grid cards (healthy first batch 24) and rail items (12)
cause: A helper function (slug, favs, setFavs, T) was removed from the homepage main engine as a "duplicate" while its kept copy lived in another script block's private scope; the engine dies with ReferenceError (PR #44, 2026-11-03)
fix: Restore the helper definitions inside the failing block's own scope, verbatim from the surviving block (emergency fix, PR #47)
prevention: Same-named functions in different script blocks are not duplicates; code cleanups ship only after a render test exercising grid, search, filters, and rails (master guide rule 8)

symptom: A listing's profile page returns 404 while the listing exists on the homepage
first_check: Check listings_master.csv profile_page column; confirm the live 404
cause: The listing was added to the homepage after the last generator run, so tools/build_places.py never built its profile family
fix: Run tools/build_places.py on current homepage data in a staging tree; ship the new family and add its URLs to sitemap.xml in the existing entry format
prevention: Any release that adds a listing includes its profile family in the same package; the six-hour watch flags new 404s

symptom: An uploaded file is the wrong size, or the live page looks half-updated after a release
first_check: Compare the committed file size on GitHub with the staged file's exact byte size before merging
cause: GitHub web uploads in this repo have stalled and truncated, silently committing a partial file
fix: Delete the bad upload once on the branch, upload again, re-verify the size before merge
prevention: Publishing instructions record the expected byte size of every file; sizes are verified per file before any merge; large releases split into lettered parts
status_example: Standing rule; verified clean on PR #47

symptom: A business website link is dead, returns 502, or shows unrelated spam content
first_check: Retest directly twice at different times; corroborate, because this machine's proxy sometimes cuts healthy sites
cause: Business closure, host failure, or domain hijack (injected spam links)
fix: Remove the website link everywhere it appears (homepage record, profile family, data JSONs, sources page) and keep the listing (PR #16 and PR #44 precedent); add hijacked domains to the never-link list the same pass
prevention: Six-hour watch re-tests outbound links and reports changes; it never edits on its own
status_example: 3 sites confirmed 502 on 2026-11-03, links removed in PR #44

symptom: Two Lighthouse runs disagree, or a performance fix does not move the score
first_check: Confirm both runs used the same tool, emulation, and page version, served from a directory verified by a marker string
cause: lhci collect defaults differ from the plain Lighthouse CLI defaults and from the CI gate; one local CLS of 0.142 on the fixed bottom tab bar was bit-identical across four page variants while an unthrottled browser recorded no shift
fix: Re-measure with the standard local method: the Lighthouse CLI bundled with the LHCI install, default mobile emulation, CHROME_PATH set to the persistent headless Chrome; report scores as local measurements only
prevention: One measurement method per comparison; a fix that does not change its target metric is reported unproven and does not ship on that claim

symptom: A section page still shows wrong or stale cards after a data fix
first_check: Look up the page in files_registry.csv; it names the data file behind the page
cause: Pages like businesses.html render from a data file (businesses.json); editing the HTML alone changes nothing a visitor sees (PR #17 lesson)
fix: Change the data file, then render the page and confirm the cards changed

symptom: Link checks report hundreds of Facebook 400 or 403 responses
first_check: Open the Facebook link signed in before calling anything dead; check the Page exists and posted within 30 days
cause: Facebook login walls and bot defenses answer unauthenticated checks; this is expected noise, not dead links
fix: Act only on a Page confirmed gone or confirmed to be a different business; otherwise leave the link and mark it unverifiable through the wall
prevention: Link reports keep "confirmed dead" and "unverifiable through the login wall" as separate counts, never merged
status_example: Standing rule; 161 expected 400s in the 2026-11-03 check

symptom: Local test results make no sense: wrong file measured, page will not load, odd server behavior
first_check: Fetch the page your local server is actually serving and grep it for a marker string unique to the intended version
cause: Stale local web servers accumulate on this machine; a new server can fail to bind a busy port and an older server answers with a different directory; the machine proxy also cuts healthy outbound connections
fix: Use a fresh port per session, verify the marker, then measure; judge the live site by byte fingerprints through the working route
prevention: Marker verification is a required step in every local measurement procedure
status_example: Bit several measurements on 2026-11-03 before diagnosis

symptom: After a rename or removal, the old name still appears on other pages or tiles break
first_check: Search the whole repo for the old name and old web address; remaining references should be zero or each explained
cause: Names surface in related pages, category pages, places.html, sources.html, the sitemap, and data JSONs, not just the listing's own pages
fix: Update every surface in one release (split into parts if needed) and verify a neighboring listing's related page afterward (PR #44 and PR #45 pattern)
prevention: The blast-radius checklist is master guide rule 6; no rename is complete on its own pages alone
status_example: Pro Temp rename and Shrimp Basket removal, 2026-11-03

symptom: English text appears while Spanish mode is on
first_check: Search the UI dictionary block in index.html for the English string
cause: The string has no Spanish dictionary entry; the translator falls back to English by design
fix: Add the Spanish entry in a staged release
prevention: New interface strings ship with their Spanish entries in the same release whenever the translation is known
status_example: Standing rule; 3 Open Now labels pending translation in the Phase 2 candidate

symptom: Visitors see an old version of the site after a release
first_check: Confirm the Pages deployment for the merge finished; fetch the live file fresh and check its size and a marker string
cause: Pages deployment lag, browser cache, and the service worker (sw.js); shared code is cache-versioned (app.js?v=16)
fix: Wait out the deployment; when a shared script changes, raise its ?v= version in the pages that load it as part of the release
prevention: Releases that change shared code note the cache version step in their summary

symptom: An API or connector call fails with 403, 429, or a permission error
first_check: Read the error, then read back the actual state (did anything get created?) before retrying
cause: Connector permissions and rate limits are real stops (Stripe product creation returned 403 twice on 2026-11-03; readback showed zero products)
fix: Stop at the stated limit; record the block in decisions_holds.csv with what would unblock it (permission fix, or the owner acting in the provider dashboard)
prevention: Never retry a denied write blindly; nothing is reported as existing until a readback shows it
status_example: Stripe sponsor products blocked, logged in decisions_holds
